purpose: Corrected fixed-load A/B replication and descriptive tests of compositional reduction against simple alternatives; no detector is fitted.
replacement_rule: No replacement, optional stopping, outcome-based point selection, or automatic extension.
allocation_semantics: A fixed sum of configured CPU ceilings, not reserved physical CPU or measured utilization. Other containers and generator share the same four-vCPU runner.

ab.group_selection: Inherit the original checkout-versus-payment/shipping contrast solely to replicate its fixed pair. This arm does not independently validate group selection or call payment/shipping non-critical.

context.group_selection: Preselect checkout, payment and shipping as the controlled subset that coordinates or participates in the synchronous checkout operation. Ad receives quota outside that tested operation. This is a structural contrast, not a claim that these are all critical services or that the sign predicts every SLO outcome.

analysis.scope: New descriptive evidence only; never pool with Probe 1 or Probe 2.
analysis.interpretation: Distinct feature values do not establish predictive superiority. Matched-feature witnesses establish only a loss of state context. Same-balance outcome discordance limits the sufficiency of the chosen scalar balance.
